text: 重磅策略会｜近600家上市公司、800余场交流，申万宏源看多明年下半年A股 申万宏源研究所预判2027年中国实际GDP增速有望保持平稳增长。
text_en: Major strategy conference | Nearly 600 listed companies and over 800 exchange sessions; Shenwan Hongyuan is bullish on A-shares in the second half of next year; Shenwan Hongyuan Research predicts China's real GDP growth is expected to maintain steady growth in 2027.
